sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Certification and Security Auditing

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of Vanuatu (Unitary National Jurisdiction; Port Vila)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law with customary law overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus Trade and Economic Integration Agreement (ratified)
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty network currently maintained; negotiations are limited to sectoral economic cooperation instruments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (No. 6 of 1992, as amended), Companies Act [Cap 191] (as amended), Anti-Money Laundering Act No. 20 of 2006 (as amended), Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap 280], and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act (as amended), together with VFSC Beneficial Ownership and Record-Keeping Directives issued pursuant to the International Companies Act.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of valid passport or national identity card for each proposed director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent public authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate shareholder or ultimate parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent corporate registrar in the country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization through the nearest Vanuatu High Commission or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source of funds/source of wealth declaration for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution, with notarized signature certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional background statement and character reference for each proposed director
Power of attorney appointing the Vanuatu registered agent (if executed outside Vanuatu)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant, duly notarized by a public notary in the country of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association or equivalent constitutional document of the ultimate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent company board and custodian of corporate records

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP screening against the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission consolidated PEP list, OFAC Specialty Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, and domestic enforcement lists. Enhanced due diligence applies to all PEPs, relatives, close associates, higher-risk jurisdictions, and beneficial ownership chains exceeding 25% direct or indirect interest. Screening must be repeated at engagement, before incorporation, and thereafter at minimum annually for the life of the entity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry online name reservation portal (submitted exclusively through a VFSC-licensed registered agent via the portal available at vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must use Latin-script characters; both English and French are official languages. Names must end with an appropriate company designator such as Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc, or an approved abbreviation, and must not be misleading, offensive, or identical or confusingly similar to an existing Vanuatu company or registered foreign company. Non-Latin names must be transliterated into Latin script in full.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant, through the VFSC-licensed registered agent, may file a written administrative appeal to the VFSC Registrar within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, attaching the rejection notice, the original reservation request, and legal submissions demonstrating compliance with the International Companies Act naming rules. The Registrar must issue a decision within 21 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Act.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not acceptable as the statutory registered office for a Vanuatu International Company. The VFSC-licensed registered agent must provide a physical street-address registered office in Port Vila, Vanuatu. Virtual office arrangements may be used only for auxiliary administrative operations and do not satisfy the registered office or commercial substance requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for passive non-licensed International Companies, estimated at less than 5% per registration year absent adverse risk indicators; materially higher if the company, its UBOs, or its registered agent is subject to a VFSC supervisory review, regulatory complaint, or sanctions-related alert.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariffs and consular fee schedules

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Act No. 32 of 1992), ss. 4, 5, 9-16 and 20 (incorporation, registration, registered office, share capital and annual fees); supplemented by the Companies Act 2009 where the constitutional documents permit corporate governance provisions.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form ICA-1) accompanied by the Memorandum and Articles of Association and the written consent of the licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up or authorized share capital applies to International Companies. Issued shares may be denominated in any currency and no escrow account, capital deposit certificate, or bank evidence is required at incorporation; allotment proceeds are recorded in the Register of Members and no solvency declaration is mandated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1/2025 - FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF VU_IC INTERNATIONAL COMPANY LIMITED. RESOLVED THAT: (1) the subscriber shares be allotted and issued fully paid and entered in the Register of Members; (2) the registered office be established at the licensed registered agent's office in Port Vila, Vanuatu; (3) the officers appointed are Chairman, Managing Director, Company Secretary, and Compliance Officer, each to serve until the next annual general meeting; (4) the Certificate of Incorporation and statutory records be kept at the registered office; and (5) the officers be authorized to open bank accounts and execute agreements for AEO supply-chain audit engagements. RESOLVED FURTHER that a copy be lodged with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Services Division via the vfsc.vu online portal and licensed registered agents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge a name reservation request verifying that the proposed company name ends with Limited or Corporation and does not conflict with any registered name under the International Companies Act 1992. Upon clearance, instruct the licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association covering share capital, registered office, objects, and director powers in accordance with ss. 9-10 of the Act.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request Form ICA-N
Proposed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber details and passport copies
Declarations confirming non-resident ownership where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected as misleading or confusingly similar, the applicant may re-file within 30 days with up to three alternative names; no re-notarization is required for substitutions made before execution of the constitutional documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarization of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public admitted and licensed by the Supreme Court of Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscriber must execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in person before a notary public. The notary attests identity, capacity, and execution date, and seals a foreign-identification affidavit where the subscriber is non-resident. The licensed registered agent countersigns the consent to act as registered agent in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum of Association
Executed Articles of Association
Notarial attestation certificate and identity affidavit
Registered agent consent and statutory declaration
Certified passport or address evidence of each director and subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarial certificate contains a defect, a fresh attestation must be executed; the agent may obtain a corrected certificate within 2 business days without restarting the incorporation filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application and payment of statutory fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form ICA-1 together with the notarized constitutional documents, the registered agent's consent, and subscriber declarations. Pay the USD 300 government incorporation fee through the VFSC-approved bank transfer or the agent's segregated trust account; elect standard processing of 5 working days or expedited 24-hour processing if required by the commercial timeline.
required_dossiers: Form ICA-1 application
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of the licensed registered agent
Power of attorney or filing authorization
VFSC fee receipt or bank transfer confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: VFSC may issue a query notice under s. 13 requiring corrective information; the applicant must respond within 14 days. Once corrected, the file is re-prioritized without an additional fee apart from any expedited charges.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation issuance and company formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After verifying the constitutional documents and confirming fee settlement, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the registration number and incorporation date. The company acquires legal personality on the date stated in the certificate per s. 15 of the International Companies Act 1992.
required_dossiers: Acknowledgment of incorporation details
Confirmation of registered agent appointment
Payment of the first annual registration fee where due
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Typographical errors in the certificate may be corrected by written application under s. 18; substantive errors require a fresh board resolution and re-filing, which the registry processes within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board governance, statutory registers, and registered office administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and the appointed Registered Agent licensed under the International Companies Act 1992
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt Resolution No. 1/2025, allot shares, open the statutory registers of members, directors, and charges, approve issuance of share certificates, ratify bank account opening, and instruct the registered agent to maintain the registered office record at Port Vila. File the annual registration fee with VFSC and confirm the company's tax-exempt offshore status where income is derived from non-Vanuatu sources.
required_dossiers: Executed first board resolution
Register of members and share allotment sheet
Register of directors and company secretary
Registered office address confirmation issued by the agent
Bank account opening forms for wire transfer and Wise payment rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a document is rejected by the agent or a bank, re-execute the affected register page or resolution and resubmit; late annual fee penalties are cured by payment of the prescribed penalty within the grace period, normally 7 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry (Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism) and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission for offshore service provider oversight; no municipal industrial licence is engaged because the activity is office-based professional auditing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt from the Vanuatu domestic business licence regime by operation of s. 6(2) of the International Companies Act 1992 where income is derived wholly from outside Vanuatu; an administrative office may require a Port Vila Municipal Council business licence for physical premises only.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geohazards, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office-based professional auditing services are not listed under the Environmental Impact Assessment (Prescribed Activities) Regulations; no environmental permit is required, and a DEPC waiver letter is recommended only where a physical office fit-out generates construction waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or stack emissions are generated. Compliance is limited to municipal solid waste segregation, e-waste recycling through DEPC-approved collectors, and adherence to Vanuatu energy efficiency thresholds for office HVAC and electrical equipment; any standby generator must meet national noise and emission limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services (Vanuatu Police Force); annual structural and electrical inspection clearance by the Port Vila Municipal Council building inspectorate; Occupational Safety and Health workplace registration with the Vanuatu Department of Labour under the Occupational Health and Safety Regulations 2005; mandatory first-aid provisioning and a documented workplace risk assessment retained at the registered office.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VACIR); official e-services and government portal: https://www.gov.vu and https://customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu does not operate a general income-tax TIN or VAT registration framework. A foreign-owned International Company (IC) must first obtain its Certificate of Incorporation and current corporate register extract from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). If the IC conducts physical import, export, or customs-related supply-chain activities, it must apply to VACIR for a Customs Business Account / Trader Identification Number under the Customs Act (Cap. 98), submitting the VFSC certificate of incorporation, registered-office consent, particulars of directors and beneficial owners, registered-agent AML/CFT compliance clearance, and the proposed AEO supply-chain declaration. No VAT identification number can be procured because Vanuatu has not enacted a VAT or GST law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, entity-classification election, or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Vanuatu law. An International Company is tax-exempt ex lege under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222), subject only to payment of annual VFSC duties and satisfaction of the statutory 'international company' activity test. No elective tax treatment is available or required.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No National VAT/GST; indirect taxation limited to Customs Import Duties, Fiscal/Excise Duties, Stamp Duty, and specific services-related taxes
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A for VAT/GST (none enacted); all commercial importers and customs AEO users must register with VACIR for a customs trader account regardless of turnover value.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory e-invoicing, fiscal digital stamping, or real-time inventory clearance regime exists. Customs declarations are processed electronically through the ASYCUDA World platform; AEO supply-chain audit operations are expected to provide advance electronic cargo information, security declarations, and cleared customs entries. Real-time fiscal clearance is not universal beyond customs risk-scored selectivity.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: there is no VAT/GST in force, so no export zero-rating claim can be made. Exports of goods are outside the domestic tax net, but the Vanuatu Customs Tariff may impose export duties on specified unprocessed commodities (e.g., certain agricultural, forestry, and marine products). An exporter must obtain a valid customs export declaration and settle any applicable export duty prior to shipment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Certificate of Origin (where preferential or duty-free treatment is claimed)
AEO/Authorized Economic Operator Supply Chain Security Certificate or equivalent customs security declaration
Inward Remittance Certificate or Correspondent Bank Credit Advice (for foreign-exchange substantiation)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no VAT zero-rating clawback mechanism because no zero-rated VAT flow exists. However, false or misleading export declarations, under-declaration of export duty, evasion of customs security requirements, and AEO compliance failures attract penalties under the Customs Act (Cap. 98), including monetary fines up to VUV 1,000,000, forfeiture of goods, suspension or revocation of AEO status, and criminal prosecution for serious fraud. Export proceeds repatriation is not statutorily timed under Vanuatu law, but documentary evidence of the foreign-currency remittance must be preserved to satisfy VFSC anti-money laundering obligations and VACIR audit substantiation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [CAP. 125]; financial-services licensing and AML/CFT supervision jointly with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act [CAP. 222] and the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [CAP. 70].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The VUV is fully convertible for both current-account and capital-account operations; Vanuatu has accepted the obligations of Article VIII of the IMF Articles of Agreement and applies no substantive exchange controls to International Companies. An IC may maintain VUV, USD, AUD, EUR or JPY accounts, and may repatriate capital, service fees and audit remuneration without central-bank pre-approval, subject only to standard AML verification and UN/OFAC sanctions screening. Residual Exchange Control Act [CAP. 61] powers concern domestic-resident transactions, which an IC is statutorily barred from conducting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No export-proceeds surrender rules apply in Vanuatu: there is no statutory repatriation timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no foreign-currency retention limit. The Exchange Control Act [CAP. 61] as amended requires only licensed-bank reporting and does not mandate conversion of export or service receipts. AEO supply-chain audit fees may therefore be collected, retained or disbursed in VUV, USD, AUD or EUR without RBV conversion approval.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VUV demand deposit with USD/AUD foreign-currency ledger; optional escrow sub-account for client audit-secured deposits)
Operational multi-currency Account (USD/VUV/EUR current accounts; segregated escrow facility available)
Operational VUV Account (USD ledger available on case-by-case approval; no escrow product for offshore ICs)
Operational Account (VUV, USD and EUR current accounts; accommodates corporate settlement for trade-intensive clients)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM (with strict documentary controls). Vanuatu has no standalone electronic-money-institution licensing regime; non-bank payment providers require a VFSC Financial Dealer Licence [CAP. 70]. Offshore digital EMIs, including Wise Business, are viable for sub-threshold USD/EUR/AUD vendor payments and client collections and match the target Wise rails, but they cannot clear VUV domestic flows and are subject to sponsor-bank de-risking and virtual-IBAN reviews. Wise may be used as a settlement add-on only; primary liquidity must remain on ANZ/BSP SWIFT rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical board meetings are not statutorily required; remote onboarding is legally permissible for International Companies. Each tier-1 bank nonetheless mandates a live audio-video KYC interview with all directors, authorised signatories and ultimate beneficial owners, plus notarised or apostilled documents, a current certificate of good standing and a VFSC-registered agent's KYC pack. In-person appearance may be waived if the compliance officer accepts biometric remote-identity verification; a notarised board resolution appointing a local authorised signatory is mandatory in all cases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore IC with an opaque UBO chain and no demonstrated real economic substance triggers conduit-entity scrutiny.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC-registered agent certificate; certified UBO register and corporate chart; IC extract from the Companies Registry; Port Vila office lease and payroll proof; WCO-compliant AEO auditor accreditation; three years of audited financial statements; tax-exemption certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or adverse-media flags: UBO, signatory or named counterparty appears on UN/OFAC/UK/EU lists, or is an unexplained PEP.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Licensed-platform sanctions-screening report with no-hit result; PEP explanation statement; independent Vanuatu legal opinion on source of wealth and funds; media-monitoring report; sworn declaration of funds signed by each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds mismatch: early inbound wires above USD 50,000 in the first 12 months unsupported by auditable AEO supply-chain audit contracts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly signed Master Services Agreements with non-resident clients; itemised invoices carrying the IMF BPM6 'other business services' description; supporting client bank statements; board minutes approving each invoice; AEO audit engagement logs and settlement ledger extracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank de-risking of Pacific offshore jurisdiction accounts, or adverse APG mutual-evaluation references, freeze or delay the IC account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Economic-substance records filed with VFSC; VFSC AML/CFT compliance certificate; six-month treasury-flow projection; evidence that all counterparties are non-resident; digital KYB package with perpetual UBO-registry access; updated AEO accreditation; audit trail of cleared non-resident invoices.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is routed via SWIFT MT103 in USD, EUR or VUV to the IC operating account with the field-70 narrative describing 'other business services (BPM6)' for service fees or 'equity injection / contributed surplus' for funding; no RBV foreign-exchange approval is needed because Vanuatu lacks exchange controls. The beneficiary bank completes only transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and UBO-benefit verification. The IC should attach a board resolution and non-resident counterparty declaration so the inflow is not recharacterised as domestic taxable revenue.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Vendor settlements are executed over SWIFT MT103 USD/EUR wires via ANZ/BSP correspondent bank networks, or by a UCP 600 commercial letter of credit issued by the Vanuatu issuing bank for AEO hardware procurement. VUV payments clear only through RBV local systems and are unavailable to ICs for resident transactions. Wise Business is permitted as a sub-threshold add-on for international subcontractor disbursements, provided each payment carries an invoice reference and UBO-registry tag for full reconciliation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable VUV/USD forward contracts up to 12 months with ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited
Deliverable VUV/EUR forward contracts up to 12 months with BRED Bank Vanuatu
Offshore USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) placed via international bank dealers for tenors beyond available deliverable liquidity
Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV) matched to AEO service-fee receivables, permitted for IC accounts without RBV authorisation
AUD/EUR forward overlays for disbursements to overseas audit teams, combined with spot-initiated SWIFT settlements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties accrue from day 31; continued default of three months may lead to administrative strike-off and reinstatement fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the due date of the Annual Return; within 14 days after any shareholding transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Misfiling or late confirmation attracts monetary penalties under the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) regulations; repeat default can require judicial remediation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: AEO Annual Security and Supply-Chain Audit Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the entity's fiscal year-end for AEO-certified operators
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit or an unsatisfactory audit result triggers suspension of AEO benefits, revocation of AEO status, and withdrawal of customs facilitation privileges.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit for a Vanuatu International Company unless imposed by a shareholder resolution, financing covenant, or the AEO certification body; AEO supply-chain audit engagements require independent third-party verification.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or internationally accepted reporting standards preferred for AEO and cross-border audit work; Vanuatu exempts International Companies from prescribed local GAAP filing requirements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Maintain a statutory register of beneficial owners, identify any ultimate shareholder changes, and submit annual UBO confirmation together with the Annual Return for each International Company year; update within 14 days of any share transfer or beneficial ownership event.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 8,000 for a single-entity AEO supply-chain audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% – Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no branch profits tax, no capital gains tax, and no payroll or social tax on an International Company. The zero-rate is automatic; no tax holiday, exemption certificate, or preferential deduction is necessary. Income derived through a permanent establishment in a foreign country may be taxed in that foreign country, but Vanuatu does not assess domestic tax on such income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return is issued or accepted. The only mandatory recurring compliance filing for an International Company is the VFSC Annual Return, filed through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-filing portal at www.vfsc.vu; a separate economic substance return is filed where a relevant activity exists.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VFSC Annual Return is due on or before the anniversary of the date of incorporation, or within such annual filing window as VFSC publishes from time to time. No fiscal-year-end corporate income tax deadline applies in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company, registration number, date of incorporation, registered agent name, and registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the registered agent's physical Vanuatu address as the service address. Non-resident directors and shareholders may enter overseas residential addresses, but supporting identity and address documents should be provided to the registered agent for AML and beneficial ownership vetting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, nationality, residential address, date of appointment, and consent of every director and, if appointed, the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals may be listed without a Vanuatu tax identification number. If the director is the registered agent or an employee of the registered agent, the agent's VFSC licence number must be cross-referenced.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Share Capital and Registered Shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, share classes, currency of denomination, consideration paid, and names and addresses of shareholders of record.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership must be disclosed to the VFSC-approved registered agent and the central register to the extent required by Vanuatu's beneficial ownership regime; bearer shares must be declared and held through an approved custodian where permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Principal Place of Business and Management Control
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Location of the registered office, principal place of business, and place where board meetings are actually held.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If back-office AEO security audit work is performed outside Vanuatu, do not state Vanuatu as the place of management unless genuinely managed there. Nominal arrangements are a strong substance red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Economic Substance Declaration and Return
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration as to whether the International Company carries on a relevant activity, including headquarters, distribution, service centre, financing, leasing, shipping, fund management, banking, insurance, or intellectual property activity; if yes, evidence of local premises, employees, expenditures, and core income-generating activities must be given.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners should evidence actual local substance with employment contracts, office leases, board minutes, and bank statements. A pure equity holding company should explicitly declare the reduced substance category to avoid the stricter relevant-activity regime.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: If no CIT return exists, no income-tax late filing surcharge applies. Failure to submit the VFSC Annual Return on time attracts VFSC late filing penalties, possible automatic default fines, suspension of the company's good standing, strike-off/dissolution, and restoration costs. Continued non-compliance may disqualify the registered agent from new business.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Vanuatu does not impose withholding tax or dividend tax on profits distributed by an International Company to non-resident shareholders. Dividends, share premium reductions, and liquidation distributions may be remitted in full without clearance from a tax authority.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable in Vanuatu. Vanuatu has not entered into comprehensive double taxation agreements and does not issue domestic tax residence certificates for income tax relief. Vanuatu has entered tax information exchange agreements / exchange of information arrangements, but these are not DTA relief mechanisms. If a foreign jurisdiction requires proof of Vanuatu tax status, the only available documentary evidence is a VFSC Certificate of Incorporation or Certificate of Good Standing; foreign tax credits must then be claimed under the investor's domestic unilateral rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0%. Vanuatu levies no withholding tax on cross-border royalties, license fees, interest, management fees, or technical service fees paid by an International Company. No reduction procedure or treaty rate is required because no source-country withholding tax exists.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None by statute in Vanuatu vatu (VUV). Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and therefore no domestic Local File or Master File threshold. As a matter of international tax prudence, OECD-compliant transfer pricing documentation should be voluntarily maintained where the Vanuatu International Company engages in material related-party cross-border transactions or where the ultimate parent jurisdiction applies CFC, CbCR, or economic substance transparency thresholds.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's International Companies (Economic Substance) legislation and regulations require an International Company carrying on a relevant activity to demonstrate real economic substance in Vanuatu: physical office premises, adequate local employees, actual local management, and performance of core income-generating activities in the jurisdiction. Pure equity holding companies are subject to reduced substance obligations. An annual economic substance declaration/return must be filed with VFSC where a relevant activity exists. Failure to satisfy the test can void the zero-tax commercial rationale, trigger penalties, and lead to VFSC strike-off and international exchange of information to the ultimate foreign tax administration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / VAT and Customs Duty Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company to create fictitious invoices, under-valuing imported goods or services in customs declarations, misusing AEO supply-chain audit privileges to circumvent customs and VAT checks, or making false representations of Vanuatu tax residence to reduce liability in a foreign jurisdiction without any underlying substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu's Value Added Tax Act and Customs Act impose monetary penalties, seizure and forfeiture of goods, revocation of customs permissions, deregistration for customs schemes, and criminal fines. International exchanges of information may expose the transaction to penalty and interest adjustments in the shareholder's home jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations or direct fraudulent customs and VAT filings may be prosecuted personally. The corporate veil is pierced for deliberate fraud; directors face civil restitution, management disqualification, travel bans pending criminal proceedings, and imprisonment for tax or customs fraud.
